text: Marcus Oyelaran presents the finished Haverbrook Tickets build to Celeste Marchbanks and engineering leadership.
catalog-api and checkout-api are live on Amazon EKS, provisioned by Terraform, deployed through GitHub Actions, and watched by Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
During a VoltPay partial outage, checkout-api returned a normal HTTP 200 for a failed payment -- and the production alert, built to catch only non-2xx responses, had no way to see it.
Oscar Bennett's support team caught it first, from real customer complaints, about 30 to 40 minutes into a 90-minute incident -- then Marcus and Ananya traced it directly from the orders database.
Next: turning this fixed alert into Marcus's and Ananya's actual on-call day.
